text.text_excerpt: I think it's a good place to go if you want big, floppy, yummy pizza. I tried the spinach and artichoke (Garlic, Parmesan, Olives, Provolone Cheese & White Sauce) and I liked it for all its juicy goodness. Every bite is so rich, buttery, and cheesy that it's hard to stop. I also tried the Pepper Pie (Peppadews, Jalepenos, Poblano Peppers, Crumbled Hot Sausage, Mozzarella & Red Sauce) and I love the flavors of the spices mixed with the sweet sauce. It's about $18 for a huge 16" which ends up not being too bad since the slices are so rich and filling. I would say this would be my go-to Sunday delivery cure for whatever I got myself into the night before but it's closed on Sundays.

Picked up a pie for dinner a while back. While I can't comment on the dine in or by the slice experience the shop looked clean and nice. The pizza was strong, I loved the thin crust. I went with the charcuterie pie - I am a topping guy, and it did not disappoint. While the pizza market in NOLA seems to be getting more crowded by the day, this is a welcome addition
